text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan  Perintah Cukai Jualan (Orang Yang
Dikecualikan daripada Pembayaran Cukai) (Pindaan) 2022.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2023.

Pindaan Jadual A

2. Perintah Cukai Jualan (Orang Yang Dikecualikan Daripada Pembayaran Cukai) 2018
[P.U. (A) 210/2018], yan g disebut "Perintah ibu" dalam Perintah ini, dipinda dalam
Jadual A—

(a) berhubung dengan  butiran 58, dalam ruang (3) , dengan menggantikan
perkataan "2710.19.43 00 , 2710.19.44 00 ," dengan perkataan
"2710.19.44 00, 2710.19.45 00, 2710.19.46 00,";

(b) berhubung dengan  butiran 58 A, dalam ruang (3) , dengan menggantikan
perkataan "2710.19.43 00, 2710.19.44 00 ," dengan perkataan
"2710.19.44 00, 2710.19.45 00, 2710.19.46 00,";

(c) berhubung dengan  butiran 60, dalam ruang (3) , dengan menggantikan
perkataan "2710.19.43 00, 2710.19.44 00 ," dengan perkataan
"2710.19.44 00, 2710.19.45 00, 2710.19.46 00,"; dan

(d) berhubung dengan  butiran 65, dalam ruang (3) , dengan menggantikan
subbutiran (a) dengan subbutiran yang berikut:

"(a)    Prime mover falling under subheadings 8701.21.90 00,
8701.22.90 00, 8701.23.90 00, 8701.24.90 00 and 8701.29.90 00
of the prevailing Customs Duties Order".

Pindaan Jadual B

3. Perintah ibu dipinda dalam Jadual B,                    berhubung dengan butiran 3—

(a) dalam ruang (3)—

(i) dengan menggantikan perkataan "0403.10.29 00" dengan perkataan
"0403.20.19 00";

(ii) dengan menggantikan perkataan "0403.10.99 00" dengan perkataan
"0403.20.99 00"; dan

(iii) dengan menggantikan perkataan "0403.90.90 90" dengan perkataan
"0403.90.90 00"; dan

(b) dalam ruang (4), dalam subbutiran (b)—

(i) dengan menggantikan perkataan "0403.10.29 00" dengan perkataan
"0403.20.19 00";

(ii) dengan menggantikan perkataan "0403.10.99 00" dengan perkataan
"0403.20.99 00"; dan

(iii) dengan menggantikan perkataan "0403.90.90 90" dengan perkataan
"0403.90.90 00".

Pindaan Jadual C

4. Perintah ibu dipinda dalam Jadual C—

(a) berhubung dengan butiran 1, dalam ruang (4)—

(i) dengan menggantikan subbutiran (b) dengan subbutiran yang berikut:

"(b)   that the goods are—

(i) imported;

(ii) purchased from another registered manufacturer; or

(iii) transported from—

(A) a licensed warehouse  under section 65 of the
Customs Act 1967 or a licensed manufacturing
warehouse under section 65 A of the Customs
Act 1967; or

(B) a free zone established under the Free Zones
Act 1990 by person acting on beha lf of a
registered manufacturer;";

(ii) dengan menggantikan subbutiran (c) dengan subbutiran yang berikut:

"(c)    that the goods shall be used in the manufacturing of finished
goods  of—

(i) taxable goods; or

(ii) both taxable and exempted goods  of the person
mentioned in column (2);"; dan

(iii) dengan memasukkan selepas subbutiran (c) subbutiran yang berikut:

"(ca)  that in the case of manufacturing the exempted goods,
the finished goods shall be exported by the person
mentioned in column (2);

(cb) notwithstanding subitem (ca), that in the case of
manufacturing the exempted goods, the following
finished goods:

(i) controlled article  under the Control of Supplies
Act 1961 [Act 122] and subject to price control;

(ii) pharmaceutical product falling under chapter 30
of the prevailing Customs Duties Order; or

(iii) milk products falling under headings or subheadings
04.01, 04.02, 0403.10.29  00, 0403.20.19 00,
0403.10.99 00, 0403.90.10  00, 0403.90.90  90,
0403.90.90 00, 04.04, 1901.10.20 00, 1901.90.31 00,
1901.90.32 00, 1901.90.39  00 and 2202.99.10 00
of the prevailing Customs Duties Order,

  may be sold locally by the registered manufacturer;

(cc)     subject to subitem (ca), if the goods mentioned in
column (3) are not used in the manufacturing
of the exempted goods and the goods produced thereof
are not exported within twelve months from the date
of import,  transport or purchas e or such other period as
approved by the Director General, the sales tax become due
and payable and the person mentioned in column (2) shall
pay for the sales tax;"; dan

(b) berhubung dengan butiran 3, dalam ruang (4)—

(i) dengan menggantikan subbutiran (c) dengan subbutiran yang berikut:

"(c)  that the goods are—

(i) imported;

(ii) purchased from another registered manufacturer; or

(iii) transported from—

(A) a licensed warehouse  under section 65 of the
Customs Act 1967 or a licensed manufacturing
warehouse under section 65 A of the Customs
Act 1967; or

(B) a free zone established under the Free Zones
Act 1990 by person acting on behalf of a
registered manufacturer;";

(ii) dengan menggantikan subbutiran (d) dengan subbutiran yang berikut:

 "(d) that the goods shall be sold to , delivered and used
solely in the manufacturing of taxable goods or both taxable
and exempted goods of the registered manufacturer;"; dan

(iii) dengan memasukkan selepas subbutiran (d) subbutiran yang berikut:

"(da)  that in the case of manufacturing the exempted goods,
the finished goods shall be exported by  the
registered manufacturer;

(db)   notwithstanding subitem (da), that in the case
of manufacturing the exempted goods, the following
finished goods  may be sold locally by the registered
manufacturer:

(i) controlled article under the Control of Supplies
Act 1961 and subject to price control;

(ii) pharmaceutical product falling under chapter 30
of the prevailing Customs Duties Order; or

(iii) milk products falling under headings or subheadings
04.01, 04.02,  0403.20.19 00, 0403.10.99 00,
0403.90.10 00, 0403.90.90 00, 04.04, 1901.10.20  00,
1901.90.31 00, 1901.90.32  00, 1901.90.39  00 and
2202.99.10 00 of the prevailing Customs Duties Order;

(dc)   subject to subitem (da), if the goods mentioned in
column (3) are not used in the manufacturing  of the
exempted goods and the goods produced thereof
are not exported within twelve months from  the date
of import, transport or purchase  or s uch other period as
approved by the Director General, the sales tax become due
and payable and the registered manufacturer shall pay for
the sales tax;".

Dibuat 12 Disember 2022
